notes: This is a flexible Nairobi/stopover hotel candidate not yet in CLAUDE.md's known priced list.

One of 8 Sarova properties covered by a single group contract with Sunworld Safaris - shared terms (cancellation, deposits, circuit discounts, group discounts) documented once here and cross-referenced in sibling files.

agentFamTripRate.raw: US$90 single, US$115 double, B&B, all year. Not applicable 15 Jun-30 Sep, Easter 3-6 Apr, Christmas 23 Dec-3 Jan.

groupRestaurantCommission: 10% commission on food for groups of 7+ pax booked for lunch/dinner at Thai Chi restaurant (not applicable on special rates)

groupDiscounts.note: Nett, not applicable on special rates/normal series/circuit discounts. 1 free per 15 paying pax, max 4 pax.

circuitDiscounts.raw: SL1 (3 Game Lodges + Stanley + one of Woodlands/Whitesands/Imperial): 12.5% off. SL2 (3 Game Lodges + Stanley or Panafric + one of Woodlands/Whitesands/Imperial): 10% off. Codes documented fully in sarova-mara-game-camp-2026.json.

childPolicy.raw: Sharing with 1-2 adults: 0-6yrs free (max 2/room); 7-12yrs 15% of single room rate (max 2 children); 13-17yrs 25% of single room rate (max 2 children). Own room: 80% of applicable full room rate (adult+1 child: adult pays single rate). 18+: adult rate.

singleRoomPolicy: Max 5 single rooms per group at single rate; additional at double rate
tourLeaderPolicy: 1 free per 15 paying pax (pre-booked/confirmed); for groups <15 pax, tour leader gets 25% off contract rates

policies.dayRoomExtension: Up to 16:00: 30% of rate; up to 18:00: 50%; beyond 18:00: full rate
policies.cancellation: 14-2 days before noon on accommodation date: 33% of rate; within 48 hours or no-show: 100%
policies.salesAllotmentSubmission: 90 days peak, 60 days high, 45 days shoulder, 30 days low season
policies.adHocGroupDeposit: 25% non-refundable within 14 days of confirmation (group = 7+ paying guests travelling together)
policies.festiveDeposit: 25% non-refundable, timing depends on booking date relative to 30 Nov/15 Dec
policies.applicability: Non-residents only, leisure business only; valid photo ID required at check-in; not for 3rd-party online distribution
